thread:
arik: Quick PR heads-up  I'm refreshing the Quickstart 'Hello App' to use ephemeral tokens and adding a tiny docker-compose for first-run. Drafting now, will tag reviewers.

mira: Nice! Can you include a short migration note for teams still using long-lived keys in frontend examples?

arik: Yep  one-liner about server-side signing vs client ephemeral tokens. Also explicit model in generate() to avoid defaults.

dev-bot: link-scan: flagged broken link => https://old.docs.redwood.inference/examples/env (404)

noah: For the docker-compose keep it minimal. Suggest node:18-bullseye-slim image and mount repo for fast iteration.

arik: Agreed. I'll add a mac M1 note recommending node:18-bullseye-slim and call out arm64 issues.

gina: Tiny nit on auth snippet param names: use ttlSeconds to match the SDK helper. Also add a refresh recommendation.

arik: Draft snippet I'll add to PR:
```js
// server-side: issue ephemeral token
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const server = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
const token = await server.auth.getEphemeralToken({ ttlSeconds: 300 });
```

noah: Looks good. Can you explicitly set model: 'rw/gtr-mini-v1' in client.generate examples? Prevents surprises.

arik: Will do. Planned reviewers: mira (copy + links), noah (compose + M1), gina (auth params). I'll open draft PR #6010 in ~15m.

mira: I can review links tomorrow 8:30am PT.

dev-bot: reminder: run `make docs-linkcheck` before merge (CI job: docs/link-check)

arik: Thanks all  will post PR link when available. :shipit:
